data.chunk_text:
 As on May 15, 2026, the area sown under summer crops is 83.08 lakh ha as compared to 80.01 lakh ha during the corresponding period of last year.  Of this, area of 31.05 lakh ha has been sown under Rice this year. There is also an increase in the area sown under Maize by about 1.50 lakh ha so far from the last 5-years average.
-

data.chunk_text: As on 15.05.2026, 96.86% of area has been harvested for Rabi crops all over India. Pulses harvest has been completed; 99.87% area of Oilseeds- majorly in Rapeseed & Mustard (100%); 98.62% area of Shri Anna cum Coarse Cereals- majorly in Jowar (99.66%), 72.70% area of Rice and 98.80% area of Wheat has been harvested for Rabi crops 2025-26.
